aggregation: Float32 native display values; overlap-weighted box mean in source coordinates; uniform output footprints; ceil dimensions
mask: Any positive-weight missing contributor invalidates the output; valid zero participates
interpolation: One bilinear interpolation of overlap-averaged display cells; positive-weight missing contributors invalidate the sample
identity: selection and native_grid_sha256 refer to the source; display_grid_sha256 identifies the derivative grid
precision: Spatial approximation for display only; no source-value or pixel displacement tolerance claimed; point/EDR/GIS remain native
cache: Existing bounded process cache; eligibility and verified source storage checked before every hit
scope: GRIB fields/1 native-display/3; no source rewrite or publication revision
